info.name: BetaCalendars Printable Calendar API Reference
info.description:
# API Reference

All endpoints are public, stateless, read-only HTTP GET resources. No API key, cookie, or user account is required. The canonical production base URL is https://api.betacalendars.com. Responses use application/json.

Calendar years are supported from 1 through 9999. The 120-month inclusive range cap keeps responses bounded. Invalid input returns a structured JSON 4xx error.

Month and layout endpoints compute their values from Gregorian arithmetic; they do not scrape or depend on the human-readable references. The references are static canonical links.

Project: https://www.betacalendars.com/

item.name: 01 Health Check
item.description: Confirm the read-only calendar API is reachable. No credentials are required. A successful response identifies only the service and health state.

item.name: Month Grid
item.description: Return a dated Gregorian month model with a configurable first weekday, row mode, and adjacent-day behavior.

item.name: Invalid month — structured 400 example

response.name: Structured input error

item.description: Demonstrate the standard JSON input error shape for an out-of-range month. This intentional example returns HTTP 400.

item.name: 07 2027 Year Summary
item.description: Get compact metadata for all twelve months of 2027 without the repeated day-cell payload.

item.name: 05 November 2026 to February 2027 Range
item.description: Summarize a chronological range inclusive of both endpoint months. This four-month fixture crosses a year boundary; range limits are 120 months.

item.name: 03 January 2027 A4 Print Layout
item.description: Calculate A4 portrait printable bounds and date-cell measurements in millimetres. Values are computed from paper dimensions, margin, header bands, and six calendar rows.

item.name: A4 Landscape Layout
item.description: A4 landscape geometry. Rotating the sheet exchanges its width and height before margins and date cells are calculated.

item.name: 04 Blank 6x7 Planner
item.description:
Create a date-free six-by-seven planning grid. Cells carry only row and column coordinates. Use the A4 measurements to plan printing.

Human-readable resource: [Blank Calendar](https://www.betacalendars.com/blank-calendar).

item.name: January 2027 Topology
item.description: Expose weekday start, month length, natural row counts for all seven week starts, fixed row count, leading offsets, and stable topology signature.

item.name: 06 Compare Year Boundary
item.description: Compare month structure across the 2026 to 2027 boundary without repeating full daily grids.
